data_output.description: data.py remains unchanged. encode(splits) must return (encoded, dimension), where encoded[split] is (features, labels, users); features is an integer array of shape (n,2) containing offset-encoded user and item IDs, labels is float32 binary long_view data in original split order, and users identifies each validation row in that same canonical order.

model_input.description: model.py must preserve Model(dimension, learning_rate, l2), logits(features), step(features, labels), predict(features, batch_size=200000), state(), and load_state(state). Model.step receives a minibatch features array of shape (B,2) and float labels of length B. It must derive per-row user counts from features[:,0], set raw_weight_i=1/max(1,n_user_i), normalize weights as B*raw_weight_i/sum(raw_weight), apply the resulting weighted BCE gradient to all existing parameters, return the corresponding finite weighted BCE loss, and preserve prediction shape/order and checkpoint compatibility.
